name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A small, dismissible-on-hover, portaled bubble that names a control or clarifies a value. Strictly informational — no actions inside. Triggers on hover-with-intent (700 ms enter / 100 ms leave) and on keyboard focus. Suppressed on touch (a long-press is not a tooltip — use Popover instead). Portaled per AGENTS.md hard rule 10.
